key_insight: The paper introduces a web-scale ophthalmology instruction dataset and training pipeline to help multimodal models better understand and converse about eye images and videos.
clinical_relevance: This could improve ophthalmic AI assistants for image-based clinical support, especially in specialized settings where domain-specific data has been limited.
method: Built OphIn-Engine to extract image-transcript pairs from open-access ophthalmology videos.
Filtered and scored visual cues to keep clinically relevant descriptions.
Synthesized high-quality VQA, multi-turn dialogue, and CoT instruction data into OphIn-500K.
evidence_signal: The authors report over 500,000 instruction instances, 151,000+ unique images, and 29,000+ video clips, with experiments showing OphIn-VL outperforms state-of-the-art general medical and domain-specific MLLMs.
watch_item: Because the dataset is derived from web-scale videos and synthetic instruction generation, quality control, bias, and real-world generalizability remain important implementation concerns.
paper_title: OphIn-500K: Curating Web-Scale Visual Instructions for Scaling Ophthalmic Multimodal Large Language Models
